target.style: Generate Honour War from the repository Screenshot reference set; preserve the reference character, environment, composition, material, lighting, combat and UI visual language rather than substituting generic MMORPG imagery.
target.camera: Derive camera distance, pitch, framing, character readability and scene composition from the Screenshot reference set.
target.lighting: Derive daylight, exposure, contrast, shadow softness, bloom and environment response from the Screenshot reference set.
target.characters: Derive full-body proportions, face/head visibility, clothing, armor, weapons, pets, silhouettes and progression presentation from the Screenshot reference set.
target.environment: Derive terrain, architecture, vegetation, roads, props, town composition and world density from the Screenshot reference set.
target.materials: Derive material appearance from the reference images, then author known plausible PBR materials in Blender/Substance 3D Painter; never use mystery materials.
target.pipeline: Screenshot → Blender → Substance 3D Painter → GLB/GLTF → Godot 4.7 Forward+
